symptom: Stage 2 occupancy stuck at ~90.3% (flat) after 7881 stage trades; Foundation pass requires 30–70%. Birth stalled stage2_metric / plateau_evolution_exhausted. No S2–S5 receipts.
first_principles_cause: S2 pass law is occupancy (flat_bars/total_signals) in 30–70%, not WR. On this NEUTRAL-heavy tape the policy stayed ~90% flat. Adaptation reached tier 3 / plateau exhaust without moving occupancy into band. exploration_active stayed false while beyond_gate force_train_lap skipped recovery.
smallest_fix: One experiment: make Stage-2 occupancy envelope actually pull flat ratio into 30–70% on this fixture (FORCE_OPEN / FORCE_HOLD vs occupancy_control_flat in sim_runner) without changing the 30–70% floor. Prove with a receipt, not a floor patch.

file_line: lumina_core/birth/foundation_metrics.py:128-136 replay_cap_ok days<=0 → False; session_unique_calendar_days / stall snapshot
